works.title: Retry expired OAuth tokens in the sync worker
works.intended_outcome: The sync worker refreshes an expired access token once and retries the failed request instead of failing the whole sync.
boundaries: Does not change how tokens are stored.

facts.statement: Implement one refresh-and-retry when a provider call returns 401.
Added refresh-and-retry to SyncWorker.fetch_page; unit tests for the 401 path pass.
Backoff for repeated 429 responses is split off as separate future work.

details.description: A 401 triggers exactly one token refresh and one retry; a second 401 fails the page.

works.title: Back off on repeated 429 responses
works.intended_outcome: The sync worker waits with exponential backoff when a provider keeps returning 429.

facts.statement: The user postponed rate-limit backoff until the token refresh lands.

deferral.reason: Postponed until the token refresh work lands.
deferral.resume_condition: After the token refresh change is merged.
